notes.title: Laser Defense Extreme - The 2025 Update
notes.content:
- The cheapest Towers are now buffed!
(Green and Red)
- Added a Hint to let Players know that you can build Towers on top of each other!
(Only when clicking on multiple Towers in the store, a placed Tower still holds a spot until it is sold)

This was unintended but I like it so I'm keeping it :)

The game should be more fair and fun now.
That's all!

notes.title: Laser Defense Extreme - Patch 3
notes.content:
- Music Player bug is now hopefully fixed.
(It would randomly stop after changing levels).

- Survival Mode is now unlocked from the start.
- The Flying Saucer's damage has been buffed.

Thank you to everybody who play Laser Defense Extreme!!

notes.title: Laser Defense Extreme - Patch 2
notes.content:
- Added another track for the level music.
- Balanced the audio levels.
- Balanced the cost of Towers

That's all :)

notes.title: Update 2 (Music and Hints)
notes.content:
Update!

- Levels now have background music.
I hope you like it :) 
I may add more tracks but making music is hard so no promises.
It's suppose to be Drum and Bass, since that was what I listened to when I was making the game.

- Added a helpful Hint Box, explaining mechanics and other helpful stuff.
- Added a Fullscreen Option in the settings:
You can't X out of the game in Fullscreen but you can
click Escape in the Main menu and that exits the game.
- Added a total wave number to the wave counter so you can see how many Enemy Waves a Map has :)

That's all!

notes.title: Update: Sandbox Mode
notes.content:
- Added Sandbox Mode
Sandbox Mode is unlocked from the start so players can check out all the mechanics without going through the main campaign first.

That's all :)

notes.title: Laser Defense Extreme - Patch 1
notes.content:
- Bug fixes
- Menu Music now has a variant and adjusted Volume

Thats all!
